rationale.consistency: Reuses sibling flag names and index.Options.Flags, but reimplements gitindex expandBranches/getCommit and index.IncrementalSkipIndexing instead of using them, and matches errors by string rather than errors.Is(plumbing.ErrReferenceNotFound).
rationale.edge_cases: Handles duplicate names, root-as-repo, .git files, bare repos, compound shards, .meta sidecars, missing index dir, no roots/args; but aborts whole sync on first repo failure and -h exits 1.
rationale.scope: Core requirement met with minimal gitindex change; adds an unrequested ~80-line branch-resolution preview path, an extra explicit sync subcommand, and source-path matching in remove.
rationale.readability: Well-named helpers with doc comments; sync loop has redundant force/non-force branches printing the same thing, and help text is duplicated between top-level and Usage.
rationale.robustness: flock guards -f runs and dry runs never write; but gitindex now lets caller name override git config for all callers (zoekt-git-index had to be changed to compensate), corrupt shards are silently skipped, and unix.Flock breaks non-unix builds.
rationale.maintainability: Clean file split, but repositoryBranches/indexUpToDate duplicate gitindex and index internals and will drift silently ("mirroring how gitindex records them"); brittle error-string comparisons.
